module_view.subtitle: Look up Jamf Pro privileges required for Jamf Dashboard actions and API endpoints.

must_not: Do not add this UI to Settings.
Do not modify Framework/UI/SettingsView.swift for this feature.
Do not bump the framework version.
Do not change JamfModule or ModuleContext contracts.
Do not create a parallel Jamf auth stack, credential store, diagnostics stack, or URLSession client.
Do not claim Jamf Dashboard can grant, override, or locally enforce Jamf Pro permissions.

acceptance_gates: All current SupportManagementAction cases map to matrix entries
All source-observed Jamf endpoints have at least a catalog or verification-required entry
Settings can browse/search action matrix and endpoint catalog
Runtime privilege diagnostics gracefully handles missing Read API Roles
403 errors include the selected action and likely missing privileges
Tests validate JSON schema and required known commands/endpoints
